description:
Full Stack Developer /Application Developer
 Location: Dulles, VA
 Must have an active Public Trust Security Clearance
 Node.Digital is supporting a U.S. Government customer on a large mission critical development and sustainment program to design, build, deliver, and operate a network operations environment, including introducing new cyber capabilities to address emerging threats.  
 Node. Digital is seeking a Full Stack Developer to support the design, development, and deployment of advanced cybersecurity capabilities.   The Full Stack Developer will play a pivotal role in our organization's technology team. 
 
 Responsibilities:
 • Full Stack Development
 o Develop, maintain, and enhance front-end and back-end components of web applications.
 o Automated testing and smoke testing familiarity and implementation experience.
 o Perform unit and integration testing to ensure software quality.
 o Optimize application for speed and scalability.
 o Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and refine software requirements.
 o Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
 o Troubleshoot and resolve software defects and issues.
 o Handle authentication, authorization, and session management.
 o Integrate with third-party services (e.g., payment processors, external APIs).
 
 • DevOps and Deployment
 o Set up and manage CI/CD pipelines.
 o Deploy applications to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
 o Monitor application performance and reliability.
 o Handle version control using Git and platforms like GitHub/GitLab.
 
 • Collaboration and Documentation
 o Collaborate with DevOps, infrastructure, and development teams to ensure seamless integration.
 o Document code and infrastructure changes, processes, and best practices.
 o Participate in knowledge sharing and mentorship of team members.
 o Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies.
 
 • Cybersecurity – Secure Coding Practices
 o Create secure code according to industry best practices.
 o Use strong encryption algorithms for data in motion and data at rest.
 o Manage and handle credentials and secrets in a secure, authorized manner.
 o Use correct error handling and logging within developed code.
 
 
 Requirements 
 Required Skills: 
 Required Skills:
 • U.S. Citizenship
 • Must be able to obtain a Secret clearance within 1 year
 • Must be able to obtain DHS Suitability
 • 8+ years of directly relevant software development experience required.
 • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, and NodeJS.
 • Strong knowledge of front-end and back-end frameworks.
 • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.
 • Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is a plus.
 • Demonstrated experience and/or familiarity with one of more of the following: SQL, Oracle, MySQL, JBDC, etc.
 • Demonstrated experience and/or familiarity with one of more of the following: Pytest, Jupyter, Java Spring, JUnit, Hibernate, JavaScript, ReactJs, etc.
 • Experience leading multiple software development teams. 
 • Experience developing system performance, availability, scalability, manageability, and security requirements for mid- to large-scale programs.
 • Experience with cloud computing, multimedia storage, knowledge databases and data-mining analytics.
 • Agile development methodology experience required.
 • Experience with Linux and/or Unix.
 • Experience with Jenkins and/or CloudBees.
 
 Desired Skills:
 • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
 • Strong teamwork and collaboration abilities.
 • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, evolving technology environment.
 • Attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
 
 Desired Certifications:
 • DoDM  8140.03 DCWF Information Systems Security Developer (631), CSSLP, CISSP
 • Software development methodology certification (e.g. SCRUM Master) highly desired.
 
 Required Education:
 • Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline is required. 
 Benefits 
 We are proud to offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to include
 Medical 
 Dental
 Vision
 Basic Life 
 Health Saving Account
 401K
 Three weeks of PTO/Sick
 11 Paid Holidays
 Pre-Approved Online Training
